503:t_112:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「A future won by taking someone's life will only breed more hatred! Please understand that!」

503:t_112:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「What's this...!? $$マリーダ$$'s words are echoing in my head!?」

503:t_112:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The $$バンシィ$$ remembers my wavelength...!? Is it interfering with Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

503:t_112:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「Stop! Don't try to get inside me!」

503:t_112:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「You monsters from space! It's $$クロノ$$'s duty to destroy you!」

503:t_113:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「You seem to have sniffed out $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$'s presence here, $$ヒイロ$$!」

503:t_113:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$ chose to live as a $$ドーリアン#relena$$, rather than a $$ピースクラフト$$.」

503:t_113:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「She chose to live by her own will, free of the family and blood you talk about. You have no right to call her a $$ピースクラフト$$.」

503:t_113:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't act like you know everything!」

503:t_113:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you're jealous, live that way yourself. If you're a man who can't do that, I'll give up on you...!」

503:t_114:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$n! I learned your habits in the simulations!」

503:t_114:3.en:
$n
「I've changed just like you, Ensign! At least I've been fighting to grow stronger!」

503:t_114:4.en:
$n
「I'll show you the results as my thanks for all the time you spent helping me train!」

503:t_114:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Try it if you can! Don't think someone like you can overcome the despair I've known!!」

503:t_115:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$!! You, at least... By my own hand...!」

503:t_115:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Ensign $$リディ$$ is serious...! Do I... have to fight...!?)
